extraction.notes: Whole readout read. The meeting agenda lists freedom of movement for workers, but the readout reports no discussion of, or claim about, Chapter 2; no chapter-basis items. Theme items come from the digital transformation and media paragraph. Left out as not material or out of scope: education, Erasmus+, youth, culture, audiovisual media agency funding, social policy and employment, gender-disaggregated data (incidental: statistics without data systems), research and innovation data for the European Innovation Scoreboard (incidental), Smart Specialisation Strategy and INOVA (no digital content stated), and the Commission's statement of support. cluster and chapter left empty for theme items: the readout gives no chapter numbers and the material is not Chapter 2. Speaker recorded as 'the Commission' as printed; the meeting year is not stated in the text, so event_date is left empty.

items.stated_text: In the field of digital transformation and media, the Commission welcomed the signature of the Grant Agreement for the AI Factory Antenna – Vezilka, and encouraged North Macedonia to continue the promising outreach activities with their neighbouring countries, developing the regional ecosystem of experts and users, also making good use of the European Digital Innovation Hubs.
items.summary: The Commission welcomed the signature of the Grant Agreement for the AI Factory Antenna Vezilka.

location.section: EU-North Macedonia 21st Subcommittee on Innovation, Information Society and Social Policy

items.extraction_note: Same sentence as the next item, which records the encouragement. Typed as the Commission's positive finding; the signature itself could also be recorded as an intervention (status adopted).

items.extraction_note: Same sentence as the previous item. TECH-DIGI added for the European Digital Innovation Hubs.

items.stated_text: The Commission also welcomed the commitment of North Macedonia to continue advancing integration into the Digital Single Market, and the implementation of the 112 European emergency number, while noting the need to provide a clear timeline for the second phase of implementation.

location.section: EU-North Macedonia 21st Subcommittee on Innovation, Information Society and Social Policy
